name: companyos
description: Your Claude Code session as a company: event feed, band above the prompt, councils, memory, tickets, accounts and a pixel office.

openOnStart.title: Open the hub when a session starts
openOnStart.description: Show the CompanyOS hub beside the transcript from the start; off, /cos opens it

protectedPaths.title: Protected paths
protectedPaths.description: Comma-separated path fragments no agent edits without your yes (e.g. .env,migrations/,infra/)

costCapUsd.title: Session cost cap (USD)
costCapUsd.description: Warn once a session costs more than this; 0 turns it off

lowPower.title: Low-power mode
lowPower.description: No office animation; the band and panes still update

webhookUrl.title: Webhook URL
webhookUrl.description: POST every event as JSON to this http(s) address; empty for none

gateCoverage.title: Done gate: coverage command
gateCoverage.description: Prints a percentage; empty turns the check off

gateCoverageTarget.title: Done gate: coverage target (%)
gateCoverageTarget.description: Below this the coverage check fails or warns
